description: This file declares functions related to directory handling in the context of Android's Cuttlefish project, including functions for obtaining various configuration and runtime directory paths as well as reading and writing data files. It is specialized for managing directories according to the freedesktop.org base directory specification.

methods.name: CvdDataHome
methods.description: Returns the path to the data home directory for Cuttlefish.

methods.name: CvdConfigHome
methods.description: Returns the path to the configuration home directory for Cuttlefish.

methods.name: CvdStateHome
methods.description: Returns the path to the state home directory for Cuttlefish.

methods.name: CvdCacheHome
methods.description: Returns the path to the cache directory for Cuttlefish.

methods.name: CvdRuntimeDir
methods.description: Returns the runtime directory path for Cuttlefish.

methods.name: CvdDataDirs
methods.description: Returns a list of data directory paths for Cuttlefish.

methods.name: CvdConfigDirs
methods.description: Returns a list of configuration directory paths for Cuttlefish.

methods.name: ReadCvdDataFile
methods.description: Reads contents from a specified data file path.

methods.name: FindCvdDataFiles
methods.description: Finds data files in a specified directory path.

methods.name: WriteCvdDataFile
methods.description: Writes contents to a specified data file path.
